title: Not that sturdy.
text: Not that sturdy.. [[VIDEOID:a7b804ba913b6fa95479b15d4d992b10]] Oh what can I say about putting this table together???? It was okay when I got the sides ready to add to that 1 bar That goes on top....Until I put my hand underneath to hold it up and was stabbed by a pc of metal from underneath. It was a long piece that was a left over when they drilled the hole. I have the pictures to show it but they might be kind of dark. I did cut it off and thats on the paper. It was in a.corner that I actually had to grab to balance the unit to put that bar on. I was surprised when I was poked so hard. It did go into the skin like a needle. Ok, now the instructions...omg..they were just a bit hard to follow for such a simple table. In the end tho I did manage to put it together correctly. In the video it shows how wobbly it turned out, even with the plugs in the legs. I put this in my living room because it was to be my puzzle table. It is not very sturdy, but it is heavy and should be ok. Because I have thick carpeting the wobbling is not as noticeable. On a good note the top Is very smooth And looks nice.Should be easy enough to wipe down to clean

product_metadata.title: Ergonomic Gaming Desk, Modern Computer Gaming Table, Home Office Work Station
features: Ergonomic Computer Desk - This gaming desk features an ergonomic design with rounded corners and curved sides, which better fit your hands, helping increase comfortability and reduce sedentary fatigue. The height of our desk is 29.7 inch, basically suitable for people of all heights.

Spacious Desk Surface – Made of sturdy eco-friendly particle board, the desktop is water-proof and wear-resistant. We’ve upgraded the gaming desk to suit gamers’ needs of more spacious desktop space. This desk is measured 43.3” ×23.6”, which is designed to easily place all your gaming gear, giving you a large surface area for your mechanical keyboard and dual monitors and help immersing yourself in the game world.

Multifunctional Modern Desk – This desk is designed in a modern minimalist style and can be matched with a variety of decorating styles. The classic appearance allows it to be used in many occasions, such as a study desk, a gaming desk or a home office workstation without taking up too much space.

Stable X-shaped Design – Made of high quality sheet metal, the X-shaped frame structure demonstrates super stability and durability, which allows this desk to support up to 135 lbs. We also equip secured pads at the bottom of the desk legs, so that the gaming desk will keep stable on all kinds of floors.

Easy to Install – The package will come with all installation tools and manual inside. Following the manual, you will find the assembly easy as pie and you will get a perfect gaming desk within 20 minutes. We’ve also uploaded the installation video on the product page. If there’s any question, please don’t hesitate to contact us and we’ll make it right for you.
description: This home office desk with a spacious surface is suitable for a variety of scenarios such as computer gaming, study, workstation. Whether for personal use or as a gift, our gaming desk is a very practical and suitable choice.
